Pomegranate Blast Ice Off Stamp Ice Cube Replacement Pod is a Off Stamp replacement part made for adults who already own a compatible device. Swapping in a fresh pod or coil restores flavor and keeps your setup running the way it did on day one.

Pomegranate Blast Ice Off Stamp Ice Cube Replacement Pod is listed at $14.99 in our Coils & Pods range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Coils & Pods](/shop/coils-pods/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Pomegranate Blast Ice Ice Cube points to a cooling finish that lifts the flavor on every inhale. Taste is subjective, and the same flavor can read sweeter or sharper depending on the device and your own palate, so use this as a starting point.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** Off Stamp
- **Category:** Coils & Pods
- **Flavor:** Pomegranate Blast Ice Ice Cube
- **Nicotine strength:** 50mg (5%)
- **Price:** $14.99
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Quick swap:** takes seconds and needs no tools or cleaning.
- **Pre-filled or ready to fill, as listed:** so you know in advance how it is meant to be used.

### About the strength
This product is listed at 50mg (5%). Compare that figure with what you currently use before you order, remember that nicotine is addictive, and speak to a healthcare professional if you have questions about it.

## Who it suits
Pomegranate Blast Ice Off Stamp Ice Cube Replacement Pod suits adult owners of the matching device who want to keep it running, and anyone who prefers to stock spares so they never run out.

## Using and caring for it
Confirm the product name matches your device before ordering, because pods and coils are not interchangeable between brands. Remove the old part, press the new one in until it seats, and let it rest for a minute before use. Dispose of used parts responsibly, store spares in a cool dry place, and keep them out of reach of children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
You can order Pomegranate Blast Ice Off Stamp Ice Cube Replacement Pod online with Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency or gift cards. Pay with crypto or a supported gift card and you save 10% on your order total. Orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free; below that, shipping is a flat $15, and the minimum order is $100.

Orders are processed within 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse and ship with tracking by a regional carrier. Because these are vapor products, an adult aged 21 or older must sign for delivery under the PACT Act, so make sure someone of age can receive the parcel.

## Returns and support
Our returns window is 30 days from purchase. Unopened products in their original packaging qualify, refunds are issued through the same payment method that was used for the order, less a 15% restocking fee, and opened or used items cannot be accepted. Contact us first so we can send an RMA form. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
